name: MBSB Berhad
overview: 2026年，MBSB Berhad 的公告主要涉及股息派发、季度业绩、股东大会及董事会委员会成员变动，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订事项。
overview_en: In 2026, MBSB Berhad's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, quarterly results, general meetings, and changes in board committee members; no expansion, new business, reduction, divestment, or contract wins were disclosed for any business segment.
